**HELIX Evolution Lab is complete and verified.** The production build succeeds, and browser checks confirmed the founder population, specimen selection, directed mutation, environment changes, generation advance, and reset all work. No JavaScript exceptions occurred.

Assumption: the existing evolutionary simulation is the intended game, so I preserved its design and mechanics. Vite reports a non-blocking bundle-size warning, and `npm ci` reported one high-severity audit vulnerability.
